finalists.label: Retroperitoneal fibrosis
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including a confluent retroperitoneal soft-tissue mass encasing surrounding vessels and bilateral hydronephrosis with extrinsic compression and medial deviation of the ureters.

finalists.label: Ureteral obstruction
finalists.why: It is directly supported by findings of mild bilateral hydronephrosis and bilateral hydronephrosis with extrinsic compression and medial deviation of the ureters.

finalists.label: Sarcoidosis
finalists.why: It is supported by the presence of a confluent retroperitoneal soft-tissue mass encasing surrounding vessels and progressively worsening symptoms, but lacks direct evidence of ureteral involvement.

frontier_selector.why: Retroperitoneal fibrosis is chosen because it accounts for both the retroperitoneal mass and the ureteral obstruction, providing a more comprehensive explanation for the patient's symptoms and findings.
